LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 8.3.1 DEMONSTRATIVES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Language use 8.3.1 Demonstratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language use 8.3.1 Demonstratives, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell others about near and far objects?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language use 8.3.1 Demonstratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: learner knowledge of who they are is enhanced as they point at parts of the body and describe them using demonstratives

Values:
Unity: Cooperation is enhanced as learners participate collaboratively in tasks such as singing, playing games among others.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Self-esteem is enhanced as the learner expresses self effectively through singing and playing games.

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Environmental Activities as learners point at parts of the body and describe them using the words: (this/ that), (these/those) in pairs or

small groups.

● Demonstratives are also emphasized in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Sample songs and poems, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners,

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
